cover_headline: Anthropic Revenue Jumps 14-Fold; Indian IT Faces AI Test
facts: Anthropic reported first-half revenue of $16.3 billion, up 14-fold year on year
TCS reported annualised AI revenue of $3.1 billion, and Infosys reported AI at 10.5% of revenue
Indian IT shares fell up to 3%, with Infosys dropping 2.31% to Rs 1,139.05 and TCS falling 2.09% to Rs 2,481.90

end.headline: Anthropic Revenue Jumps 14-Fold; Indian IT Faces AI Test
end.line: Claude maker's $16.3 billion first half and IPO filing lifted chip stocks but knocked TCS and Infosys, even as AI passes 10% of their revenue
